name: SEATEXT FREE Translation and Conversion Rate Boost
author: Seatext.com

sections.description:
Welcome to SEATEXT AI – the first AI for websites that actively improves your website, for free.

🌎 100% FREE TRANSLATIONS (no limits!)

Simply activate SEATEXT AI, and it automatically translates your entire website into over 125 languages. You can manually edit any translation if needed. Get 1TB of free storage for your translated media with a one-click download option. You can also utilize our advanced AI, which generates 10 translation variants and allows you to A/B test them, eliminating translation errors and increasing conversion rates from your international pages. SEATEXT AI instantly detects new content and translates it automatically – no manual action required. Our translation AI utilizes an advanced engine that first analyzes your entire website to understand its content before translating, providing a more contextual and accurate approach. SEATEXT AI also automatically shows Google bots these translations, enabling them to be indexed quickly and appear in search results – so all Seatext translations are SEO friendly. We offer these translations completely free – no credit card needed. SEATEXT AI also automatically detects the visitor’s language, eliminating the need for clunky language switchers. Our AI is intelligent enough to understand the preferred language of each visitor.

🤖 AI IMPROVES TEXT ON YOUR WEBSITE AND CONVERSION RATES

SEATEXT AI utilizes a unique AI that emulates the proven strategy of Amazon.com to improve conversion rates and copy, leveraging over 12,000 A/B tests per year. Our AI creates multiple versions of your website text and automatically uses them in A/B testing to determine which variations drive better sales and conversions. The system constantly generates new content and tests it, resulting in typical sales increases of 35% within three months. All optimization happens automatically and is completely free! You have complete control, with the ability to edit AI-generated variants, add your own (using SEATEXT as your A/B testing platform!), approve them for testing, manage testing itself, and approve the best variant to receive up to 90% of your website traffic. SEATEXT AI offers three different ways to regulate which text needs fine-tuning: you can even delegate this task to the AI, allowing it to understand which text has the most significant impact on your conversion rates. Our AI can also follow your brand guidelines and text styles, a feature not offered by any other A/B testing platform. Another benefit: you don’t need to configure conversion events in your Google Analytics or tags – SEATEXT is intelligent enough to understand what constitutes a conversion. All textual variants are SEO friendly as we strictly follow Google recommendations about AI content and A/B testing.

🛡️ AI-SMART GDPR COOKIES

We created the world’s smallest cookie popup, designed to minimize impact on your conversion rate. Large GDPR/CCPA cookie popups and consent banners can significantly hinder your conversion scores. Visitors may not see your content, spend only 3 seconds to close your banner, and average 25 seconds on your website – losing valuable time that could be spent converting. SEATEXT offers a minimal yet readable cookie consent that doesn’t block anything on your website, preventing it from negatively impacting your conversion rates. Additionally, once a user consents on any website with SEATEXT AI installed, the AI remembers their preferences across all websites. For many visitors, based on their location or previous consent, you won’t need a popup at all! This feature is free forever, with no limits.

📱 AI NOW CAN DO MOBILE OPTIMIZATION

Many websites make a crucial mistake – using the same long desktop text for mobile users. This long text doesn’t convert, as users encounter multiple screens of text, leading to quick abandonment. Our AI automatically rewrites your content to be perfectly readable on mobile screens. It generates 10 different content variants and continuously A/B tests them to find the most effective mobile versions, improving your mobile conversion rates automatically and increasing the time people spend on your website. All mobile textual variants are SEO friendly as we strictly follow Google recommendations about AI content and A/B testing.

🎯 AI PERSONALIZATION – now you can ask AI to rewrite the website for each visitor

Connect your CRM, email database, or external data sources like clay.com or cohere.com and ask GPT to create a prompt for each of your potential clients. Then, give these prompts to SEATEXT AI to rewrite your page for each prospect. Generate personalized links for every customer with just one click – ideal for ABM, targeted campaigns, and cold email. Send these links, and your customers will see your website rewritten specifically for them. This personalization can range from basic actions like adding customer names and company names to titles to a deeper understanding of customer values, problems, and fine-tuning your message precisely for them. No other personalization tool offers this opportunity at scale!

🛍️ AI FOR WOOCOMMERCE

Your store can now boost sales with SEATEXT AI. Following the strategy of Amazon, our AI generates 10+ product descriptions for your goods and A/B tests them to determine which versions drive higher sales. These high-converting product descriptions are then automatically pushed to the majority of your visitors, leading to improved sales. If this magic isn’t enough for you, SEATEXT will also translate your store into 125 languages with a single click, completely free. All WooCommerce product variants are SEO friendly as we strictly follow Google recommendations about AI content and A/B testing. Both features are free forever!

Truly free – No limits! Unlike Weglot, WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, GTranslate, Loco Translate, MultilingualPress, Babble, ConveyThis, Transposh, WooCommerce Multilingual, and others.

WORKS WITH ALL MAJOR PAGE BUILDERS:

🎨 Elementor (Free & Pro)
🎯 Divi Builder
🛠️ WPBakery
🦫 Beaver Builder
💨 Oxygen Builder
🎪 Brizy
📈 Thrive Architect
🎭 Visual Composer
⚡ Gutenberg
🧱 Bricks Builder
⚡ ZionBuilder
🎨 LiveCanvas

The first AI to actively improve your website’s – for free!
